metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 1970 · The Vampire Doll
metas.description: A young man goes missing after visiting his girlfriend's isolated country home. His sister and her boyfriend trace him to the creepy mansion, but their search becomes perilous when they uncover a gruesome family history.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.2 · 1971 · Lake of Dracula
metas.description: A doctor investigates the murders of several women at a lakeside resort. His investigation leads him to believe that a vampire is responsible for the murders. He sets out to track the vampire down.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.3 · 1974 · Evil of Dracula
metas.description: A teacher assumes a position at a school that's run by a vampire.
